results.problem: Expected energy-norm error for Galerkin reconstruction in sample-based quantum Krylov sampling
results.quote: Let S be the set of distinct indices observed with M/d shots on each Krylov state. Then \(\mathbb{E}\big[\|x_\mathcal{S}-x^*\|_A^2\big]\le\lambda_\mathrm{max}\sum_z|\hat{x}_z|^2e^{-Mq\left(z\right)}.\)

results.problem: Sample complexity for expected energy-norm accuracy

results.quote: For \(0<\delta<1\), if \(M\ge\frac{\mathrm{ln}(|\mathscr{E}_\epsilon|/\delta)}{q_\mathrm{min}(\mathscr{E}_\epsilon)},\) then with probability at least \(1-\delta\) every index of \(\mathscr{E}_\epsilon\) is observed and \(\|x_\mathscr{S}-x^*\|_A\le\epsilon\|x^*\|_A\).

results.problem: Lower bound on shots and sampling efficiency
results.quote: Any sampling protocol needs \(M\ge K_\epsilon\) shots, because each shot adds at most one index. ... We therefore define the sampling efficiency \(\eta_\mathrm{s}=|\mathscr{E}_\epsilon|q_\mathrm{min}(\mathscr{E}_\epsilon)\le 1.\)

results.problem: Robustness to replacement noise in the outcome law
results.quote: Suppose that each shot is independently replaced, with probability \(p<1\), by an index drawn from an arbitrary distribution. Then the outcome law satisfies \(q'(z)\ge(1-p)q(z),\) and the sufficient budget of Corollary 3 increases at most by the factor \(1/(1-p)\).

results.problem: Support completeness of the dephased outcome law
Spectral bounds for elliptic operators on Riemannian cross sections
results.quote: Let C be diagonal with entries in \([c_\min,c_\max]\). Then \(\lambda_\mathrm{min}(K)+c_\min\le\lambda_\mathrm{min}(A)\le\lambda_\max(A)\le\lambda_\max(K)+c_\max.\)

results.problem: Stability under metric perturbation (Class I approximation)
results.quote: Let \(\tilde{A}=A+\delta A\) with \(|\langle v,\delta Av\rangle|\le\epsilon\langle v,Av\rangle\) for all v and some \(\epsilon<1\), and let \(\tilde{b}=b+\delta b\) and \(\tilde{x}=\tilde{A}^{-1}\tilde{b}\). Then \(\frac{\|\tilde{x}-x^*\|_A}{\|x^*\|_A}\le\frac{\epsilon+\|\delta b\|_{A^{-1}}/\|x^*\|_A}{1-\epsilon}.\)

results.problem: First-order shape perturbation bound via Lie derivative of the metric
results.quote: Hence Proposition 15 applies, to first order, with \(\epsilon=|s|\mathrm{max}\big\{\mathrm{sup}_\Omega\frac{1}{2}(\mu_1-\mu_2),\mathrm{sup}_\Omega\frac{1}{2}|\mu_1+\mu_2|\big\},\) and with \(\delta b=s\mathrm{diag}(\mathrm{div}_gV)b\), when \(\rho\), \(\gamma\), and f are transported with the deformation.

results.problem: Symmetry selection rule for measurement outcomes
results.bound: q(z)=0\text{ and }\hat{x}_z=0\text{ for every index with }\chi_z\neq\chi
results.quote: If the measurement basis F diagonalizes P, with \(FPF^\dagger=\mathrm{diag}(\chi_z)\), then q(z)=0 and \(\hat{x}_z=0\) for every index with \(\chi_z\neq\chi\).
